reason: In src/sentry/workflow_engine/endpoints/validators/base/detector.py:64, update() reads validated_data.get("detector_type", instance.group_type). The serializer field is `type` (line ~35, set by validate_type), and nothing in workflow_engine ever fills in a `detector_type` key, so update() always falls back to the existing type and a requested type change is silently ignored.
